title: Thailand
tagline: Temples, islands and the best street food in Asia
description: Thailand is the easiest big holiday from India — a short flight away and endlessly fun. Bangkok dazzles with the golden spires of the Grand Palace and Wat Arun, floating markets, rooftop bars and world-class shopping malls.

On the coast, Pattaya's Coral Island offers white sand and water sports, while Phuket opens the door to limestone islands, turquoise lagoons and long beach days. Add smiling hospitality and unbeatable value, and it's no wonder travellers return again and again.
